findings_addressed.oracle: Independent oracle: the exact offset (5) and data (b'\x01\x02') are the values injected by write_bytes, matched against the patch_map built from get_patches() - the test asserts patch_map[5] == b'\x01\x02', which is a concrete value check not derivable from the get_patches() output alone.
findings_addressed.documented_mutation: In src/intellicrack_hexcore (Rust), change get_patches() to always return patches with offset 0 instead of the real written offset; this makes patch_map[5] a KeyError, failing the assertion `write_offset in patch_map`.

notes: Renamed test from test_patch_list_entries_are_two_tuples to test_patch_list_entries_record_exact_offset_and_data to reflect the strengthened oracle. Replaced type/shape assertions with exact offset and data value assertions. The test now fails if get_patches() returns wrong offset or wrong data bytes, making it a genuine gate for the production write_bytes -> get_patches pipeline.
